THE IDEA

A home for unfinished thinking.

An idea rarely arrives fully formed. Fieldnotes is a small experiment in giving those early thoughts somewhere to land, without asking them to become anything yet.

Try the scratchpad below. Your writing is saved on this device when browser storage is available. It stays here until you clear it; it is never sent to a server.
